e.title: **一份 59 亿字节的「复现包」：它把整篇论文的代码与数据压成一个可引用的编号**（Zenodo DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22659308`）——**作者三人**、**均附 ORCID**、**关键词只有三个**（**genetic prediction、**adverse selection、**insurance**）；**⭐ 它**没有**任何指向代码仓库的关联标识**（**即**这份包**只存在于存档里**）**；**⭐ 版本字符串自带日期**（`v0.9.2  （2026-07-29）`**）**，**而**记录创建于 2026-09-08****
e.title_en: A replication package of nearly six gigabytes that compresses an entire paper code and data into one citable identifier: a Zenodo record whose three creators each carry an ORCID, whose keywords are exactly genetic prediction, adverse selection and insurance, which carries no related identifier pointing at any code repository, so the package exists only in the archive, and whose version string carries its own date while the record itself was created later.
e.title_hk: **一份 59 億位元組的「複現包」：它把整篇論文的程式碼與資料壓成一個可引用的編號**（Zenodo DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22659308`）——**作者三人**、**均附 ORCID**、**關鍵詞只有三個**（**genetic prediction、**adverse selection、**insurance**）；**⭐ 它**沒有**任何指向程式碼倉庫的關聯標識**（**即**這份包**只存在於存檔裡**）**；**⭐ 版本字串自帶日期**（`v0.9.2  （2026-07-29）`**）**，**而**記錄建立於 2026-09-08****
e.summary: **Replication Package for: Genetic Prediction and Adverse Selection**（Zenodo 记录 `22659308`；**DOI 逐字为** `10.5281/zenodo.22659308`，**概念 DOI 为** `10.5281/zenodo.22659307`）**是一篇论文的**复现包**，**描述逐字为**「**Replication package for: Azevedo, E., Beauchamp, J.P., and Karlsson Linnér, R. (forthcoming). Genetic Prediction and Adverse Selection. Econometrica.**」**——**⭐ 即**它把「**代码与数据**」作为**论文的一个可引用附件**交付**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「存证」**，**它是四条里把「**可引用**」的**最简形态**展示得最清楚的一条**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 只有一个文件**——**逐字名为** `Replication-Package.zip`，**实测 6,344,986,631 字节**（**约 5.9 GiB**），**并附一个** md5**校验和**（**逐字为** `md5:5f0f0b9d2d308ed1c3e58e8182c680e1`**）**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它**没有任何关联标识****（**本次实测其 `related_identifiers` 为空**）**——**⭐ 即**这份包**不在任何代码仓库里**（**至少**Zenodo 上没有登记指向某个仓库**）**，**读者只能从存档里下载**；**⭐⭐ ③ 版本字符串与创建时间分开**——**版本逐字为** `v0.9.2  (2026-07-29)`（**版本名里自带一个更早的日期**）**，**而记录创建于 2026-09-08**；**⭐⭐ ④ 元数据极简**：**关键词只有三个**（`Genetic prediction`、`Adverse selection`、`Insurance`**）**、**许可** CC-BY-4.0**、**访问权限** open**、**无禁运期**、**无备注**；**⭐⭐ ⑤ 登记分层**：**版本 DOI** 与**概念 DOI** 分开**，**故**引用可指向「**这一版**」或「**这个复现包**」**。**⚠️ 本次未下载该压缩包、**未读其中任何文件**（**5.9 GiB，**且**内容构成未核实**）**；**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**本条的价值在**登记与引用形态**，**而不在其内容的可核性****。
e.summary_hk: **Replication Package for: Genetic Prediction and Adverse Selection**（Zenodo 記錄 `22659308`；**DOI 逐字為** `10.5281/zenodo.22659308`）**是一篇論文（**Econometrica**）的**複現包**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「存證」**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 只有一個檔案**——`Replication-Package.zip`，**實測 6,344,986,631 位元組**（**約 5.9 GiB**），**並附 md5 校驗和**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它**沒有任何關聯標識****（`related_identifiers` 為空**）**——**⭐ 即**這份包**不在任何程式碼倉庫裡**；**⭐⭐ ③ 版本字串自帶更早的日期**（`v0.9.2  (2026-07-29)`**）**，**而**記錄建立於 2026-09-08**；**⭐⭐ ④ 元數據極簡**（**關鍵詞僅三個**、**許可** CC-BY-4.0、**訪問** open、**無禁運**）**；**⭐⭐ ⑤ 版本 DOI 與概念 DOI 分開**。**⚠️ 本次未下載該壓縮包、未讀其中任何檔案**。
e.summary_en: The Zenodo record titled as a replication package for a paper on genetic prediction and adverse selection, under a version DOI and a concept DOI, **delivers one paper code and data as a single citable attachment**: its description states verbatim that it is the replication package for a forthcoming article in a leading economics journal by three named authors. **This entry belongs to the round theme of evidence and citability, and of the four it shows the simplest possible form of citability**: a single file named as a replication package, measured at more than six billion bytes, roughly five point nine gibibytes, carrying an md5 checksum; **no related identifier at all**, so the package is not registered as living in any code repository and a reader can only obtain it from the archive; **a version string that carries its own earlier date while the record itself was created later**; deliberately minimal metadata, with exactly three keywords, namely genetic prediction, adverse selection and insurance, a Creative Commons attribution licence, open access and no embargo; and both a version DOI and a concept DOI, so a citation can point either at this version or at the replication package as an idea. **The archive was not downloaded and none of its files were read this round, and this entry states plainly that its subject is the registration and citation form rather than the checkability of the content.**
e.body:
**Replication Package for: Genetic Prediction and Adverse Selection**（**Zenodo 记录** `22659308`）**是一篇论文的**复现包**。**本次实测**：**DOI 逐字为** `10.5281/zenodo.22659308`**、概念 DOI 为** `10.5281/zenodo.22659307`**、**版本逐字为** `v0.9.2  (2026-07-29)`**、**类型** Software**、**许可** CC-BY-4.0**、**创建与更新均为 2026-09-08**、**访问权限** open**、**无禁运期**、**记录无备注字段**；**文件**只有 **1 个**，**逐字名为** `Replication-Package.zip`，**实测** 6,344,986,631 字节**，**并附校验和** `md5:5f0f0b9d2d308ed1c3e58e8182c680e1`**；**三位作者**逐字为** `Azevedo, Eduardo`（**ORCID** `0000-0001-6048-6506`**）**、`Beauchamp, Jonathan P`（**ORCID** `0000-0002-4935-4016`**）**、`Karlsson Linnér, Richard`（**ORCID** `0000-0001-7839-2858`**）**；**关键词逐字只有三个**：`Genetic prediction`、`Adverse selection`、`Insurance`。**本条目属于本轮主题**「**存证：编号、版本、许可，以及把每个数追回它的来源**」**；**本词条认为它是四条里把「**可引用**」的**最简形态**展示得最清楚的一条**——**⭐ 而它也同时暴露了这种形态的**边界**。

**可核实信息（均 Zenodo 元数据实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 整篇论文的代码与数据被压成一个文件、一个编号**——**描述逐字为**「**Replication package for: Azevedo, E., Beauchamp, J.P., and Karlsson Linnér, R. (forthcoming). Genetic Prediction and Adverse Selection. Econometrica.**」**；**⭐ 即**这份归档**不是一篇论文**，**也不是一个软件项目**，**而是「**论文的复现材料**」这一**独立可引用的对象**——**⭐ 本词条认为这正是「**存证**」的最简形态：**一个压缩包 ＋ 一个 DOI ＋ 一行「**它对应哪篇论文**」。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它**没有任何关联标识**——**本次实测其 `related_identifiers` 为空****，**即**既没有指向代码仓库、**也没有指向论文的 DOI、**也没有指向该论文的预印本**。**⭐ 本词条如实记录这一处**：**⭐ 它与本站第 346／352 轮记下的「**来源与生成物要能互相找到**」**相反**——**在这里，**论文与复现包之间**只靠**描述里那句话**相连**，**而**没有机器可读的链接**（**⚠️ 本词条只记录「**Zenodo 元数据里没有**」这一事实，**不推测作者是否有意如此**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 版本字符串自带一个**更早**的日期，**而记录创建更晚**——**版本逐字为** `v0.9.2  (2026-07-29)`**，**删除线**（**若按「**版本名里的日期 = 该版本形成时间**」理解**）**它**比记录的创建时间 2026-09-08 **早约六周****；**⭐ 即**「**我什么时候把它提交到存档**」与「**这一版是什么时候形成的**」**是两件事——**⭐ 而后者只能从版本字符串里读出**（**⚠️ 本词条未核实该日期含义**）**。**⭐⭐ ④ 元数据极简到几乎只有必要项**——**关键词三个、**许可一个、**访问权限一个、**文件一个、**作者三个**；**⭐ 即**它**没有**填 `notes`、**没有**填资助信息、**没有**填关联标识**；**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**这不是缺陷，而是**一种取舍**——**存档记录**只承担「**编号、版本、许可、作者**」四件事**，**其余交给论文本身**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 两层 DOI 的分工**——**版本 DOI**（`10.5281/zenodo.22659308`）**指向**这一次提交**，**概念 DOI**（`10.5281/zenodo.22659307`）**指向**这个复现包**（**跨版本不变**）**；**⭐ 即**引用者可以选「**我引的是这一版**」或「**我引的是这个概念**」——**⭐ 这与 Zenodo 对所有记录的统一做法一致**（**本站池内已有 8 条 Zenodo 来源条目为同一形态**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 主题与池内条目的关系**：**关键词只有三个，**而三个都在本站的射程内**（**基因预测、**逆选择、**保险**）**——**⭐ 逆选择是保险经济学的核心议题之一**，**而「**用基因信息预测风险**」**把它推进到**信息与公平**的层面**；**⭐ 本站 [[insurance-fairness]]、[[insurance-fairness-ldp]]、[[underwriting-decision-safety]]、[[insurance-governance]] 覆盖**公平性、**承保决策与治理**，**[[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]] 覆盖**定价方法的论文形态**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**论文复现包**」这一形态**（**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**这在本站池内**并非全新**——池内已有 [[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]] 与 [[frmtpl-scaling-laws]] 这类「**论文＋代码**」组合**，**但**以**单一压缩包＋DOI＋无仓库关联**的形式出现的**，此前没有**）**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]]、[[insurance-fairness]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「**一篇论文的复现材料可以长什么样**」的一个极简样本**：**一个压缩包、**一个 DOI、**一条 md5、**三个关键词**；**⭐ 而它对本站最有价值的一点是**反面的**：**它提示「**只把东西放进存档**」会让**代码与论文之间缺少机器可读的连接**——**⭐ 这与本站第 346／352 轮「**来源与生成物要互相指得回去**」的纪律正好对照**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有下载**那份 6.3 GB 的压缩包、**没有解压、**没有读其中任何文件**（**未读代码、**未读数据、**未读 README**）**，**故不主张**其中任何方法、结果、数据或结论**成立**；**⭐ 本词条**只知道「**有这样一个文件、这么大、这个校验和**」**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未核实该压缩包的内容构成**（**是否含数据、**是否含代码、**是否含受限数据**）**——**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**；**⭐ 并如实指出**：**一份 5.9 GiB 的「**复现包**」**很可能包含**大体量数据**（**例如基因型数据**），**而**其**许可与再分发条件**可能与**记录级许可（CC-BY-4.0）**并不相同**——**⚠️ 本次未核实，**故**不对其可否再分发作任何主张**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实论文本身**：**未查该文是否已在 Econometrica 发表或仍在**forthcoming**状态、**未读摘要或正文、**未核实三位作者与该文的对应关系**；**⚠️ 描述里的**forthcoming**是**本次所见的原文措辞**，**本词条**不据此判断其发表状态**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实版本字符串** `v0.9.2  (2026-07-29)` **里日期的含义**（**本次只记录该日期早于记录创建时间**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实 `related_identifiers` 为空**是否只是**本记录**未登记**（**本词条只主张「**该字段本次为空**」）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实三位作者的身份与机构**；**⚠️ 未记录下载量与引用数**。**⑦ ⚠️ 许可为 CC-BY-4.0（记录字段）**，**本次**未见独立许可文本**；**⭐ 本词条按惯例区分「**记录级许可**」与「**包内数据自身的权利**」**，**并因此**不对其再分发作任何主张**。**⑧ ⚠️ 记录创建 2026-09-08 在解冻窗口之内**，**故本条不需要窗口例外**；**⭐ 但本词条如实指出**：**「**单一压缩包＋DOI＋md5＋无仓库关联**」这一**极简复现包**形态，此前池内没有对应物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。

**Replication Package for: Genetic Prediction and Adverse Selection**（**Zenodo 記錄** `22659308`）**是一篇論文的**複現包**。**本次實測**：**DOI 逐字為** `10.5281/zenodo.22659308`**、概念 DOI 為** `10.5281/zenodo.22659307`**、**版本逐字為** `v0.9.2  (2026-07-29)`**、**類型** Software**、**許可** CC-BY-4.0**、**建立與更新均為 2026-09-08**、**訪問** open**、**無禁運**；**檔案只有 1 個**（`Replication-Package.zip`**，**實測 6,344,986,631 位元組**，**附 md5 校驗和**）**；**三位作者均附 ORCID**；**關鍵詞逐字只有三個**：`Genetic prediction`、`Adverse selection`、`Insurance`。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「**存證**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 Zenodo 元數據實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 整篇論文的程式碼與資料被壓成一個檔案、一個編號**——**描述逐字為**「**Replication package for: Azevedo, E., Beauchamp, J.P., and Karlsson Linnér, R. (forthcoming). Genetic Prediction and Adverse Selection. Econometrica.**」**——**⭐ 即**這份歸檔**不是論文、**也不是軟體專案**，**而是「**論文的複現材料**」這一**獨立可引用的對象**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它**沒有任何關聯標識****——**實測其 `related_identifiers` 為空****，**即**既未指向程式碼倉庫、**也未指向論文 DOI 或預印本**——**⭐ 即**論文與複現包之間**只靠描述裡那句話相連**，**而**沒有機器可讀的連結**（**⭐ 本詞條只記錄「**該欄位本次為空**」**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 版本字串自帶一個**更早**的日期**（`v0.9.2  (2026-07-29)`**，**比記錄建立時間 2026-09-08 早約六週**）**——**⭐ 即**「**何時提交存檔**」與「**這一版何時形成**」**是兩件事**。**⭐⭐ ④ 元數據極簡**（**關鍵詞三個、**許可一個、**檔案一個**，**未填備註、**未填資助、**未填關聯**）**——**⭐ 不是缺陷，而是取捨**：**存檔記錄只承擔「**編號、版本、許可、作者**」。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 兩層 DOI 的分工**（**版本 DOI 指向這一次提交，**概念 DOI 跨版本不變**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 主題與池內條目的關係**：**三個關鍵詞都在本站射程內**（**基因預測、**逆選擇、**保險**）**；**本站 [[insurance-fairness]]、[[underwriting-decision-safety]]、[[insurance-governance]] 覆蓋公平性、**承保決策與治理**，**[[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]] 覆蓋論文形態**——**⭐ 但**以「**單一壓縮包＋DOI＋無倉庫關聯**」形式出現的複現包**，此前池內沒有**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]]、[[insurance-fairness]] 應當並讀**——**它給的是「**論文複現材料可以長什麼樣**」的極簡樣本**；**⭐ 而它對本站最有價值的一點是**反面的**：**只把東西放進存檔**，**會讓**程式碼與論文之間缺少機器可讀的連接**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有下載**那份 6.3 GB 壓縮包、**沒有解壓、**沒有讀其中任何檔案**，**故不主張**其中任何方法、結果、資料或結論**成立**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未核實該壓縮包的內容構成**（**是否含資料、**是否含受限資料**）**——**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**；**⭐ 並如實指出**：**一份 5.9 GiB 的複現包**很可能包含**大体量資料**，**而**其**權利條件**可能與**記錄級許可（CC-BY-4.0）**不同**——**⚠️ 故**不對其可否再分發作任何主張**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實論文本身**（**未查是否已發表、**未讀摘要或正文**）**；**描述裡的**forthcoming**是本次所見原文措辭**，**不據此判斷發表狀態**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實版本字串裡日期的含義**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實關聯欄位為空是否只是本記錄未登記**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實三位作者身份與機構**；**未記錄下載量與引用數**。**⑦ ⚠️ 許可為 CC-BY-4.0（記錄欄位）**，**未見獨立許可文本**；**按慣例區分「**記錄級許可**」與「**包內資料自身的權利**」**。**⑧ ⚠️ 記錄建立 2026-09-08 在解凍窗口之內**；**但「單一壓縮包＋DOI＋md5＋無倉庫關聯」這一極簡複現包形態，此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。

e.body_en:
The Zenodo record titled as a replication package for a paper on genetic prediction and adverse selection **is the reproducibility artefact of that paper**. **Measured this round**: a version DOI and a concept DOI; a version string that is a semantic version followed by a date in parentheses; resource type Software; **licence CC-BY-4.0**; **created and updated on 2026-09-08**; open access with no embargo and no notes field; **exactly one file**, named as a replication package and **measured at 6,344,986,631 bytes**, roughly five point nine gibibytes, **carrying an md5 checksum**; three creators, each with an ORCID; and **exactly three keywords**, being genetic prediction, adverse selection and insurance. **This entry belongs to the round theme of evidence and citability, and of the four it shows the simplest possible form of citability while also exposing that form boundaries.**

**Verified information, all measured from the archive metadata**: **first, an entire paper code and data is compressed into one file and one identifier.** The description states verbatim that this is the replication package for a forthcoming article in a leading economics journal by three named authors. **The archive is therefore neither a paper nor a software project but a separately citable object that holds a paper reproducibility material**, which this entry considers the minimal form of citability: one archive, one identifier, and one line saying which paper it belongs to. **Second, it carries no related identifier at all**: the related-identifiers field is empty, so it points neither at a code repository nor at the paper DOI nor at a preprint. **The paper and its replication package are joined only by that sentence in the description, with no machine-readable link**, which runs opposite to the project convention recorded in earlier rounds that sources and generated artefacts should be able to find each other. **This entry records only the measured fact that the field is empty in this record and does not speculate about the authors intent.** **Third, the version string carries an earlier date than the record itself**: the version reads as a semantic version followed by a date, and that date is about six weeks earlier than the record creation date, **so when the package was deposited and when this version was formed are two different things, and the latter is legible only from the version string, whose meaning was not verified here.** **Fourth, the metadata is minimal to the point of containing almost only the necessary fields**: three keywords, one licence, one access right, one file and three authors, with no notes, no funding information and no related identifiers. **This is not a defect but a tradeoff in which the archive record carries only the identifier, the version, the licence and the authors, leaving everything else to the paper.** **Fifth, the two DOI layers divide the work**: the version DOI points at this submission while the concept DOI is stable across versions, so a citation can say either that it refers to this version or to the replication package as an idea, which matches the uniform practice already visible in the eight Zenodo-sourced entries in the pool. **Sixth, the subject relates to existing entries**: all three keywords fall inside this wiki range, since genetic prediction, adverse selection and insurance touch the core of insurance economics, and the pooled fairness, underwriting decision safety and governance entries cover the fairness and decision side while the pooled ratemaking scaling paper entry covers the paper-with-code form. **This entry does, however, state plainly that a paper-plus-code combination is not new to the pool; what is new is a replication package appearing as a single archive with a DOI and no repository link.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]] and [[insurance-fairness]]**, because **it is a minimal sample of what a paper reproducibility material can look like, being one archive, one identifier, one checksum and three keywords**, and because **its most useful lesson is a negative one: depositing material in an archive without linking it leaves code and paper joined only by prose**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the six-gigabyte archive was not downloaded, not extracted, and none of its files were read** — no code, no data, no README — **so no method, result, dataset or conclusion inside it is claimed to hold; this entry knows only that such a file exists, at that size, with that checksum**. **Second, the contents of the archive were not established**, including whether it contains data, whether it contains restricted data, and in what proportion; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **It is also stated plainly that a package of nearly six gigabytes is likely to contain substantial data, such as genotype data, and that the rights attaching to such data may differ from the licence recorded at the record level, so no claim is made here about whether it may be redistributed.** **Third, the paper itself was not verified**: whether it has appeared or is still forthcoming was not checked, no abstract or text was read, and the correspondence between the three creators and the article was not established; the word forthcoming is the wording seen in the record and is not used here to infer publication status. **Fourth, the meaning of the date inside the version string was not verified**, only that it precedes the record creation date. **Fifth, whether the empty related-identifiers field merely reflects an omission in this record was not established**; this entry claims only that the field was empty when measured. **Sixth, the three creators and their affiliations were not verified, and download and citation counts were not recorded. Seventh, the licence is CC-BY-4.0 by the record field and no separate licence text was seen; this entry follows the project convention of distinguishing a record-level licence from the rights attaching to the data inside the archive, and therefore makes no claim about redistribution. Eighth, the record was created on 2026-09-08, inside the thaw window, so no window exception is needed; however, the shape of a minimal replication package consisting of a single archive, a DOI, a checksum and no repository link had no counterpart in the pool. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**
